versions.changelog:
Initial release of command-execution skill for safe, auditable command runs.

- Supports executing terminal commands with preflight risk checks and gating.
- Requires specifying both the command and its purpose.
- Classifies and blocks high-risk operations (e.g., recursive deletes, remote scripts) unless explicitly confirmed.
- Preferentially uses dry-run flags to reduce risk.
- Captures and summarizes results, checks expected effects, and proposes diagnostics on failure.
- Enforces safety rules—no destructive or remote-script commands without explicit user review.
